+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build an inventory list: item name, quantity, location Warehouse/Shop/Home, status In stock/Low/Out of stock, edit and delete
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+A SQLite table stores inventory items. A database module offers add, list, update, and delete functions. FastAPI routes under /api/items call them. A single HTML page lists items with coloured status badges, a form to add one, and Edit and Delete buttons on each.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Inventory list
+
+Keep track of items in your inventory with their name, quantity, location, and status.
+
+**items**: name (string), quantity (number), location (Warehouse / Shop / Home), status (In stock / Low / Out of stock). Operations: list, create, update, delete.
+
+Features:
+- Form to add an item with name, quantity, location, and status
+- List of items showing name, quantity, location, and status badge
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every item
+- Filter the list by location (Warehouse, Shop, Home)
+
+## Endpoints
+- `POST /api/items`: Add an item to the inventory
+- `GET /api/items`: List all items, newest first
+- `PUT /api/items/{id}`: Edit one item
+- `DELETE /api/items/{id}`: Delete one item
+
+## Web page must
+- Form with name, quantity, location select (Warehouse, Shop, Home), and status select (In stock, Low, Out of stock) and a Save button
+- List of items showing name, quantity, location, and status badge
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every item
+- Show error messages from the API

    import collections, re
    ids = re.findall(r'\sid=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', client.get('/').text)
